SEARCH

Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search

package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search
This package contains objects used for a search query:
  • The SearchQuery class is used to send the query parameters.
  • The SearchResult class is used to get the results of the search.
  • The SearchResultWithParentInfo is extension of SearchResult with additional parent information.
